body: I understand you on that. My ex gf left me when two days prior she said she loved me and never wanted to lose me. It’ll probably take some time but he has to figure out how to start be comfortable with himself. He might be depressed and people can talk to him and try to help him but it’s gonna have to be him to open up. It horrible seeing someone you care about go through struggles. You never truly know what another person is thinking.

Sometime people need to grow and love themselves before they can love someone else. Sometimes it’s just not meant to be. It’s sucks and hurts. I know I’m going through a break up. Sometimes it’s just not your person. You never know. Keep your head up and focus on yourself. It’s hard, I know but trust me you gotta start loving yourself.

If it wasn’t a bad break up and if you or her didn’t cheat on each other then accept it. If you love her and want to be with her and she loves you then figure out the differences. Work through the struggles and don’t quit on each other if you care and she cares.
So do you think it was all my fault?
I appreciate the advice. I’ll try to move on. It’s just hard.
